senses.gloss:
शान् €1 U. (शीशांसति-ते, strictly a desiderative of शान् used
 in a primitive sense) To sharpen, whet.

सन् €1 P., €8 U. (सनति, सनोति, सनुते, सात; pass. सन्यते,
 सायते; desid. सिसनिषति; सिषासति)
—1 To love, like.
—2 To
[]
 worship, honour.
—3 To acquire, obtain.
—4 To receive graciously.
—5 To honour with gifts, give, bestow, distribute.
